The key concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By deploying powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser, while also using removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to control the board, this deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent into making suboptimal plays. The inclusion of cards like Liliana of the Veil and Ertai Resurrected also provides additional disruption and flexibility in dealing with various threats.
